technique_name: Identify two ways technology is changing the marketing industry.
description: Technology is transforming the marketing industry in many ways. First, digital platforms have enabled companies to target specific audiences more effectively, allowing marketers to be precise about who to target and when. Many digital marketing tools also enable marketers to monitor customer behavior and gain precise analytics about the success of their campaigns.
